text: Added a generated Markdown plus machine-readable acceptance ledger preserving all 9 global and 35 phase criteria. Thirty-two evidence entries map current APIs, module ownership, exact suite tests/scenario IDs, parity fixtures, and bounded commands; all candidate statuses remain honestly not_run. The documentation gate now resolves every path and test/scenario reference, enforces criterion counts/status/candidate shape, and prevents ledger drift. Documentation synchronization and the 32-entry scenario manifest validation pass.
